title: Roles and priority decide who changes what; others send change requests
rationale: User decision, 2026-10-10. Members have one role: Owner, Engineer, Purchaser or Viewer. The Owner gives each member a priority. When two members change the same field, the higher priority wins; equal priority (for example, two engineers) means the app asks which value to keep. Someone without enough access or priority is told so and can send a change request, which waits in the inbox of every member with higher priority to accept or reject, like a pull request. Roles replace the single Edit access setting (users.can_edit_catalog) from 2254.
